tools.name: search_courts
tools.description: Use this when a group wants bookable court options near a UK location on one date or across a bounded date range. Searches configured providers, normalizes known whole-court and per-player prices, adds catalogue venue IDs and coordinates, and returns at most the requested limit across all dates. Pro

tools.name: search_clubs
tools.description: Use this lightweight directory lookup to find clubs by location and facilities or resolve a club description, nearby landmark, or partial club name into candidate club_id, club_name, and provider values. Put only club-name wording in query; add location when an area was supplied. Use court_type for

tools.name: search_public_games
tools.description: Use this when a player wants an existing public padel game with an open spot. Omit date, time, level, and limit filters unless the user requested them; by default it returns every matching game around the location across the next 14 UK days. Returns anonymous match metadata and the provider join pag

tools.name: search_activities
tools.description: Use this when a player wants scheduled PadelStars activities such as coaching, training, intro sessions, socials, junior sessions, or competitions. Returns live session times, levels, vacancies, prices when published, and the provider booking page. It never joins, books, or pays on the user’s behalf

tools.name: get_club
tools.description: Use this after a Zarvo club ID is known and the user wants its address, coordinates, facilities, racket rental, contact information, official website, or social links. This returns directory metadata, not live availability.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Use this when the user has selected a named provider club and wants its available courts on one date or across a bounded date range. tools.name: recheck_slot
tools.description: Optional standalone check. get_booking_handoff already revalidates before returning a URL; call this only to confirm availability without proceeding to handoff. It never books, holds inventory, takes payment, or returns checkout.

tools.name: create_game_plan
tools.description: Use this only when the user explicitly wants to organise one to three selected court options with other people. Rechecks each selected slot, creates an expiring Zarvo plan, and returns separate guest and private organiser links. This changes Zarvo state but does not book a court.

tools.name: get_booking_handoff
tools.description: Use this directly after the user chooses a slot. It revalidates the provider slot and returns status unavailable with a reason if the slot was taken, or status available with a provider handoff URL and current price.
